security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://127.0.0.1:*; img-src 'self' data: blob: http://127.0.0.1:*; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; worker-src 'self' blob:

bundle.shortDescription: Save editing, repair and walkthroughs for visual novels
bundle.longDescription: Nodex reads Ren'Py, RPG Maker MV/MZ and Unity visual novel saves locally, edits variables through a verified round trip, repairs corrupted saves, maps every choice as a graph and unlocks galleries.
